text:
maria: Hey team — incoming external pentest report landed (attached). 12 findings, 3 high, 4 medium. Need to coordinate retest window, RBAC changes, KMS evidence, and who owns remediation + packaging. Quick sync here to assign owners.
aj: Ack — can you drop the attachment link? Also need to know if any of the high issues require live access for the assessor (ephemeral roles) or just logs/configs.
maria: Link: https://redwood-sec.s3/assessments/2026-03-20/external-report.pdf
maria: High #1 involves token leakage in debug endpoints — we'll need logs + stack traces, no live access. High #2 is IAM misconfig on admin role mapping (likely RBAC change). High #3 is KMS key policy allowed broad principal.
tom: For logs/export, SRE can snapshot CloudTrail and API gateway logs. I'll queue a retention export and presigned link.
lina: @tom please include the filtered time range (2026-03-01..2026-03-15) and obfuscate PII before handing off. We should also include proof of key policy change history (kms:DescribeKey CloudTrail events).
tom: Will do. Plan: create a read-only evidence bundle with hashed filenames, upload to the assessment bucket, and generate presigned 7d URL.
katie: DevEx can own the remediation runbook template + the retest checklist (canary steps, verification prompts). I can produce a canned prompt set for the quality team to validate regressions after changes.
aj: On ephemeral access: We should avoid broad assessor creds. We'll create timeboxed IAM role with a single assume-role window for the retest. Are we ok with that approach?
maria: Yes — pen tester needs assume-role for the retest only. We'll provide an access window and monitor via live audit. Also require MFA for the assume.
lina: For KMS policy change: we need to snapshot key policy current state, team owning key (infra-keys), and a proposed least-priv policy. Who owns infra-keys?
tom: infra-keys lives with infra-team; tagging indicates owner is "infra-platform". I'll ping them in a sec.
tom: @infra-platform tagging: can you prepare policy diff and sign-off for key 'rw-main-v1' by EOD Thu?
pen-test-bot: assessment-bucket: evidence upload succeeded (bundle-2026-03-20.tar.gz) — presigned URL created, expires 2026-03-27.
maria: Great. Owners so far: High #1 (debug endpoints) = @lina for logs and fixes; High #2 (IAM mapping) = @aj for RBAC change + rollout plan; High #3 (KMS policy) = @infra-platform / @tom to coordinate evidence and policy diff; DevEx runbook = @katie.
aj: For RBAC change rollout: propose canary on 10% of admin traffic via rollout policy in console, rollback toggle if errors > 1% or auth failures spike. Need acceptance criteria.
katie: I'll add acceptance criteria: successful auth rate >= 99.5, no increase in 5xxs, and unit tests updated. Also include prompt tests to assert correct role scoping.
lina: Remediation verification steps for logs: provide the following query snippets for evidence (CloudWatch Insights sample):
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /token\s+leak|debug/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100
```
Please include sample hits and indicate remediation timestamp.
tom: I'll run queries and attach sample hits with an HMAC of the bundle to preserve chain-of-custody.
maria: Scheduling retest: assessor available Mon 2026-03-29 and Thu 2026-04-01. Prefer Mon for initial retest. Can all owners have check-in ready by Fri EOD?
aj: Friday EOD is tight for RBAC thorough testing. Request extension to Mon morning for a final dry-run, still aiming for retest Mon afternoon.
lina: Ok I can get logs + samples ready by Fri EOD, but need dev sign-off for the code fix rollout; @aj please confirm if your RBAC change blocks me.
aj: It shouldn't block logs. I'll aim for Mon morning final tests. If we need to delay retest to Tue we can but prefer Mon.
katie: I'll publish the runbook by Thu COB and reach out to QA to run the prompt verification set on Fri.
maria: Action items recap:
- lina: produce log snapshots + sample hits + obfuscated artifacts (due Fri EOD)
- aj: RBAC change plan + canary config + dry-run (due Mon AM)
- infra-platform/tom: KMS policy diff + evidence + presigned key event logs (due Fri EOD)
- katie: remediation runbook + prompt/verification tests (due Thu COB)
- tom: upload HMAC'd evidence bundle (done) and send link to assessor (done)
If any blockers ping here.
pen-test-bot: note: retest-window created for assessor (session-8942) — start 2026-03-29T13:00Z end 2026-03-29T16:00Z.
maria: Thanks all. If anything needs an escalation path, flag with :rotating_light: and @oncall. We'll run a quick dry-run playbook on Mon 09:30 before assessor session.
aj: I'll run the dry-run and report back with metrics.
lina: Copy — starting log export now.
katie: I'll DM QA and schedule the verification run.
maria: Closing the loop: add any notes or constraints here. Otherwise we'll treat Fri as internal checkpoint and Mon as retest. :thumbsup:
